summary: Flathead NF lookout on Elbow Point near Seeley Lake: shake cabin built 1926, L-4 tower 1942, removed 1977; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Shake-framed cupola cabin (1926); standard L-4 cabin on a 30-foot tower (1942)
facts.status_note: Removed by the Forest Service in 1977 per the Pathfinder; firelookout.com says it was destroyed in 1977

staffing.status: seasonal observers named from 1952; last staffing noted 1972

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says the cabin was destroyed in 1977; the Pathfinder says the Forest Service removed the lookout that year. Both put the end in 1977, so the story reports both accounts.
The Montana list uses Elbow Mountain; the Pathfinder history places the lookout on Elbow Point. Same site, two names.

notes_for_editor: History is well covered by two independent sources (firelookout.com and the 2026 Pathfinder column). No source describes what remains today, so the story says so. Brief access 'unknown' is omitted because no access level is supported. The OpenStreetMap point is a map entry, not evidence of a structure. The firelookout.com photo (credited to the Fire Lookout Museum) was not added because no image URL was found. Page reads ran over the six-read budget because of repeat reads of cached pages.
